about: NASA FIRMS hotspot rows near the watch areas; columns as in the FIRMS CSVs, plus "file" (which CSV). Inside a haze box at most 10 rows per satellite per UTC day are kept (highest frp first); a satellite-day with more has a "hazeDayTotals" entry counting every row in the box: per confidence value as given, [rows, summed frp], plus the detection times.
